build_WindowedEMGDataModule: build a PyTorch Lightning data module to load windowed EMG datasets for training, validation, and testing
build_TDSConvCTCModule: build a PyTorch Lightning module with a TDS-Conv encoder and CTC loss for EMG-to-text decoding
test_WindowedEMGDataModule_setup: test the WindowedEMGDataModule setup method to create ConcatDataset instances from HDF5 session paths
test_TDSConvCTCModule_forward: test the TDSConvCTCModule forward pass to compute log-probability emissions from EMG spectrogram inputs
review_TDSConvCTCModule_step: review the TDSConvCTCModule _step method to compute CTC loss and character error rate metrics per batch
